description:
Get an 8-K's earnings release as filed

Return the earnings release (EX-99.1) an 8-K filed: every numeric table cell with its row label, column heading and the scale the table states, exactly as filed, and the latest period end its headings name. A release files a quarter's figures before the 10-Q; it is not normalized into the canonical statements, and the 10-Q that follows it is the statement. Release tables are not XBRL-tagged, so every value's concept is null and every value is reported. 404 when Arche has read no earnings release for the accession.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.
